texts: Google Pixel phones, starting from the Pixel 3, do not feature a microSD card slot for expandable storage. Earlier models, such as the Pixel and Pixel XL, did include a microSD card slot to allow users to expand their device's storage capacity. However, with the shift towards more integrated designs and increased base storage options, Google opted to remove this feature in later models to enhance the phone's water resistance and streamline the design.

Google Pixel phones do not come with a memory card slot for expandable storage. This has been a consistent design choice throughout the Pixel lineup, from the original Pixel released in 2016 to the latest Pixel 8 series. Instead, Google emphasizes cloud storage through Google Drive and offers different internal storage options (usually 128GB, 256GB, or 512GB variants) to meet users' storage needs.

Google's reasoning behind this decision aligns with their cloud-first approach and follows a trend also seen with Apple's iPhone. They argue that cloud storage provides more flexibility and security, while removing the memory card slot allows for a more streamlined design and better water resistance.

The Pixel 6 Pro briefly experimented with expandable storage through a hidden microSD slot, and the Pixel 7 series introduced a unique dual-slot system that could accommodate either two SIM cards or one SIM card and a microSD card up to 2TB. However, these features were only available in select Asian markets where expandable storage is in higher demand.

Yes, some Google Pixel phones do have a microSD card slot for expanding storage. For example, the Google Pixel 3 and Pixel 3a models support microSD cards, allowing you to add up to 512GB of additional storage. However, it's important to check the specific model you are interested in, as newer models might have different features.

No, Google Pixel phones do not have memory card slots (microSD card slots). Google has never included expandable storage in any of its Pixel phone models. Instead, Google encourages users to utilize cloud storage (Google Drive/Google One) and offers different internal storage options (64GB, 128GB, 256GB, etc.) depending on the model.
